coil_notes.16: Hold winding of the trapdoor coil. SolTrapDoorLow actually raises the flap and enables TrapDoorKicker while asserted, despite the routine name. The factory test checks both outputs8/16 and ball feedback45/77.
coil_notes.17: Two #906 bulbs on the Headquarters circuit. Render lights l117a-e paint effects; they are not five sockets.
coil_notes.18: One #906 bulb at Safehouse. Six script-driven l118 Lights are glow helpers, not six bulbs.
coil_notes.19: One #906 bulb lights the Warehouse. Six l119 helpers do not prove six sockets.
coil_notes.20: 12VDC motor through motor EMI board. A-18581 crank/drive plate oscillates the gun using one motor output. Position76 is a mechanical home mark;77 is the under-playfield ball lockup switch, not motor feedback.
coil_notes.21: One #906 Gun Loaded bulb. The l121a-c helpers do not identify three sockets.
coil_notes.23: Two #906 bulbs: a playfield right-rear dome and a rear-panel bulb. The table also shares GIWhite1 glow with output24; this is a rendering defect, not a shared physical lamp.
coil_notes.24: Two #906 bulbs: a playfield left-rear dome and a rear-panel bulb. Script l124 lights and shared GIWhite1 are rendering helpers.
coil_notes.25: Production: no fitted load; sample DROP RESET removed by amendment16-10007, including its tieback diode. T.4 still names and pulses25.
coil_notes.29: Virtual J111 GPIO bit5. PinMAME publishes WPC_GILAMPS bit5 here; observed in the retained boot/service runs. No physical coil29 exists: printed29 is the lower-right power winding at public45.
coil_notes.30: Virtual J111 GPIO bit6. Core publishes the bit, but no retained source establishes a machine meaning or observed transition. Physical printed30 is lower-right hold at public46; it does not bind here.
coil_notes.31: Virtual WPC_GILAMPS bit7 mirror. This driver has no fast-flip RAM address, so it is the legacy GameOn/J111 state, not a direct physical coil. Printed31 is lower-left power at public47.
coil_notes.32: Reserved core bit11; wpc.c stores only bits8-10 from WPC_GILAMPS (no fastflip on dh), so this is constant zero. Printed32 is lower-left hold at public48.
coil_notes.33: Printed flipper circuit 33. PinMAME power callback aggregates power and hold bits; it is not a measurement of the power winding alone. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.34: Printed flipper circuit 34. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.35: Printed flipper circuit 35. Magnet uses the upper-left power output, not a fourth flipper. The flipper diagram footnote misprints upper RIGHT, but draws the starred upper-left circuit; the solenoid table, wiring sheet and table callback35 agree on magnet35.
coil_notes.36: Production: no fitted load; sample LEFT LOOP GATE removed by amendment16-10007. T.4 still names and pulses36; this is the raw upper-left hold bit, not a fourth-flipper hold winding on this game.
coil_notes.4: AE-23-800 per amendment16-10007, which replaces AE-24-900. Manual production tables already carry the corrected part. WarehousePopper.SolOut drives the top-right popper behind the warehouse entrance.
coil_notes.45: Printed flipper circuit 29. PinMAME power callback aggregates power and hold bits; it is not a measurement of the power winding alone. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.46: Printed flipper circuit 30. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.47: Printed flipper circuit 31. PinMAME power callback aggregates power and hold bits; it is not a measurement of the power winding alone. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.48: Printed flipper circuit 32. Power and hold windings share one physical flipper assembly; repeated effect location is deliberate.
coil_notes.49: Simulator-only shooter-release state. sim_getSol(49) returns shooterRel; it is meaningful simulator state, not a machine coil. The known-working recreation disables built-in mechanics/keyboard and drives physical autoplunger2.
coil_notes.50: Reserved simulator address: sim_getSol only returns a value for49, hence50 is constant zero.
coil_notes.6: Production: no fitted load, explicitly removed by amendment16-10007. LX-2 still calls this DROP TARGET DOWN, drives it in T.4, and pulses it at startup. This is explained sample-machine firmware activity, not production fitment.
coil_notes.8: High-power winding of trapdoor A-19282/A-14701, with hold output16. The retained script comments out callback8 and animates the door from16 only; this is a table simplification, not an absent physical circuit.

switch_notes.44: The physical gun chamber opto is independent of trigger11 and the under-playfield mini-trough. sw44 destroys the simulated ball and sets44. SolGunLaunch mistakenly clears coin switch3 instead of44 on its enabled branch; its disabled branch clears44 after firing. This is a consumed-table defect.
switch_notes.76: Mini-micro switch5647-12693-21 on the motor crank. The manual T.17 says it closes with the gun almost pointing at the backbox and opens before counter-clockwise travel. The script writes76 at its own -4 degree mark; that angle is table tuning, not physical calibration.
switch_notes.77: Mini-micro switch5647-12693-46 in the gun mini-trough, with ball switch45. Manual T.18 explicitly requires both to close as a ball passes. Script SolGunMotor writes77 equal to motor state: a feedback substitution, not physical motor-switch causality.

29.label: J111 GPIO Bit 5
29.notes: Virtual J111 GPIO bit5. PinMAME publishes WPC_GILAMPS bit5 here; observed in the retained boot/service runs. No physical coil29 exists: printed29 is the lower-right power winding at public45.

30.label: J111 GPIO Bit 6
30.notes: Virtual J111 GPIO bit6. Core unconditionally exposes WPC_GILAMPS bit6 at public30, the same state-channel contract as bit5 at29. This identifies transport, not a production coil or an asserted game-specific function. No30 transition was observed in the retained probes; that does not make this published state unused. Physical printed30 is lower-right hold at public46; it does not bind here.

31.label: Legacy GameOn / J111 Bit 7
31.notes: Virtual WPC_GILAMPS bit7 mirror. This driver has no fast-flip RAM address, so it is the legacy GameOn/J111 state, not a direct physical coil. Printed31 is lower-left power at public47.

32.label: Reserved Core Bit 11
32.notes: Reserved core bit11; wpc.c stores only bits8-10 from WPC_GILAMPS (no fastflip on dh), so this is constant zero. Printed32 is lower-left hold at public48.

49.label: Simulator Shooter Release
49.notes: Simulator-only shooter-release state. sim_getSol(49) returns shooterRel; it is meaningful simulator state, not a machine coil. The known-working recreation disables built-in mechanics/keyboard and drives physical autoplunger2.

50.label: Reserved Simulator Address
50.notes: Reserved simulator address: sim_getSol only returns a value for49, hence50 is constant zero.
